headline: Drive-thru beer and wine sales almost a reality in Alabama
snippet: ABC board set rules for implementation, sales possible by January 2023.

headline: Legislature approves bill allowing alcohol to be sold through drive-thru windows
snippet: Drive-thru and walk-up beer/wine sales for off-premises consumption.

headline: Alabama House OK's bills for drive-thru alcohol sales
snippet: Any retailer licensed for off-premises sales can sell through drive-through.
